metadata.description:
Did you know that although the French language comes from France, lots of people in Canada speak French, too?! Of the nearly 37 million people living in Canada, 22% of them learn French even before they learn English!

Interested in learning this fascinating language? Here’s a great place to start! Join Sophie and Silas in this fun and interactive card as they teach you 100 commonly-used words in French… from bonjour to au revoir!
metadata.author: Yoto
